properties.entry:
Parameter comment blocks are not allowed

Message No. FUNC_ADT028

Diagnosis

You tried to save a comment block that contains parameter declarations in the source code of a function module.

Example:

*"----------------------------------------------------------------------
*"*"Localinterface:
*" IMPORTING
*" VALUE(TEXT) LIKE CHAR10
*"----------------------------------------------------------------------

System Response

It is not allowed to save a function module containing a comment block with parameter declarations. This coding might be created by copy and paste and could lead to the deletion of the mentioned parameters.

Therefore, the changes to the function module are not saved.

Procedure

Remove the comment block. If you declared parameters, ensure that they are declared in the function statement. Save the function module, again.

Example:

FUNCTION MY_FUNCTION_MODULE
IMPORTING
VALUE(TEXT) TYPE CHAR10.

Procedure for System Administration
